dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and prominent pale edges provide high-contrast boundaries along the margins of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Low distinctness; a gradual transition where fine longitudinal head streaking merges into the broader scalloped pattern of the mantle without a clear linear boundary.
